subject: nvd3 graph not showing with rCharts in Shiny

messages.author: ad1a6abcb84542f8
messages.subject: nvd3 graph not showing with rCharts in Shiny
parts:
Good day everyone,

I am having some problems when trying to show my NVD3 graph (using rCharts library) in shiny. I have opened an issue in rCharts but maybe it's something I'm just doing wrong in Shiny/ RStudio... https://github.com/ramnathv/rCharts/issues/431.

Below is the text of the ticket I opened. thanks for all the help.

I am working with a shiny app that is using rCharts to produce leaflets maps. I want to additionally have nvd3 graphs but I can't for the life of me make the graph to appear inside the shiny app.

I have tested the code locally with RStudio and it does not show inside RStudio (but in Chrome it appears correctly).

When running the shiny app, instead of the graph showing inside Shiny, it stays blank and if I go to the "Viewer" tab in RStudio and I click on the arrow, it opens a new Chrome window with the graph correctly produced.

I then copied the code in this example (http://ramnathv.github.io/rNVD3/- the one that produces http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ramnathv/rNVD3/) and changed the "NVD3" library for "rCharts" changing the showOutput("myChart") for showOutput("myChart", "nvd3").
If I do that, I get the same problem than with my app... should I be using the "NVD3" library instead of rCharts? (because I've tried that also without any luck).



--
Sent from my netBook

messages.author: ad1a6abcb84542f8
messages.subject: Re: nvd3 graph not showing with rCharts in Shiny
parts: After looking here, I changed renderChart in server.R to renderChart2 and this fixed the issue.
